feat(grok): adopt activity leases

  version: 1
  authority: FWN-13
  description: |-
    Replace the temporary fixed Grok prompt deadline with policy-scoped acknowledgement timing and renewable lifecycle-v2 activity evidence.

Isolate idle/resource expiry to the affected retained session and require recovery without manufacturing progress or failing the business operation.
